source_document: APY Subscriber Information Brochure / PFRDA APY Eligibility

rules.condition: Individual must be at least 18 years old to join Atal Pension Yojana.
Individual must be no more than 40 years old to join Atal Pension Yojana.

notes: APY also requires the applicant to be an Indian citizen and have a savings bank account or post-office savings bank account. These requirements cannot be evaluated because the current profile does not collect citizenship or bank-account status.

From 1 October 2022, a citizen who is or has been an income-tax payer is not eligible to open a new APY account. The current profile collects income but does not collect income-tax-payer status, so income is not used as a proxy for this requirement.
